GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 433 (24 Dec 45) ESS/PC
(SCAPIN-499)
APO 500
24 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Price Schedule for Rice.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government. CLO No. 996 (2. 4) dated 10 December 1945, subject: "State Liability Due to Government Purchase and Sale of the Rice Produced in 1945".
2. Approval is hereby granted to effectuate the proposed ricesales program which fixes the standard government price of rice at ¥ 150.00 per koku and defrays fifty per cent of this cost from government sources.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
